sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND b.category = 'Advertisement' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND b.category = 'Advertisement' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM 
    event e
JOIN 
    budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE 
    b.category = 'Advertisement'
GROUP BY 
    e.event_name
HAVING 
    e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')
